c2.note: Ruddarraju is CTO of Compute and Raji CTO of Applications; no company-wide CTO is identified.

c3.note: Reuters confirms Murati, Zoph and McGrew announced departures in September 2024.

c4.note: Thurrott states Murati left, created a new AI startup, and her role will not be replaced.

c5.note: Wikipedia gives May 2022 to September 2024 tenure; Reuters corroborates promotion in May 2022.

c7.note: The primary source matches the announcement, role, reporting line and date.

c9.note: The release says Raji will head product engineering for ChatGPT and Codex; TIME in Sept 2026 confirms he still leads them.

c10.note: GeekWire dated Mar 7, 2026 calls him OpenAI's CTO of Applications.

c11.note: TIME, published Sep 22, 2026, lists him as chief technology officer of applications at OpenAI.

c12.note: DCD (2026-07-20) reports he was appointed CTO for compute; CNBC-TV18 also says he became CTO Compute in July 2026.

c15.note: CNBC on Oct 14, 2026 calls him OpenAI's CTO of compute, and he now leads the overall compute organization.

c17.note: A spokesperson said Ruddarraju will replace Katti; Katti's last day is Nov 15, so the handover is in progress or imminent. Both variants C and E match.

c18.note: He is a former xAI infrastructure head named CTO of Compute in July 2026. Calling the October expansion an 'appointment' is slightly loose.

c19.note: DCD says he joined last July as head of compute and infrastructure; this is background history.

c20.note: He was promoted to CTO, Compute in July 2026 after a year as Head of Compute and Infrastructure.

c21.note: His team builds the compute, networking and storage systems used to train frontier models, and he leads compute strategy including commercial strategy. This role description is consistent across sources.

c22.note: Katti announced he is leaving his infrastructure role and will remain an advisor.

c24.note: CNBC lists Simo (July), Lightcap and Dresser (August) and Katti as 2026 departures. Simo moved to an advisory role, and Katti's last day is still pending as of today.

c25.note: Multiple outlets report that Narayanan, CTO of B2B applications, announced his departure on 2026-04-17. The claim is dated and describes an old event rather than the current CTO. The saved evidence pages don't mention him, so this rests on my own search.

c9.note: OpenAI's Sept 2, 2025 announcement named Raji CTO of Applications, reporting to Fidji Simo. Several outlets say he covers product engineering for ChatGPT and Codex. 2026 sources still give him this title, and no report of him leaving was found.

c15.note: Named CTO of Compute in July 2026 (DCD, Business Today, YourStory and others). As of Oct 14, 2026, coverage still gave him this title.

c16.note: CNBC (Oct 14, 2026), citing an OpenAI spokesperson: Ruddarraju, already CTO of compute, takes over from Sachin Katti as leader of OpenAI's compute organization.

c20.note: He joined in July 2025 as Head of Compute and Infrastructure and was promoted to CTO of Compute in July 2026, about one year later.
